purpose: Make the Phase 0/1 control chain legible at human scale through three participant-authored concept perspectives and bounded reversible-prototype cards.
claim_boundary: The perspectives are not site photographs, surveys, existing-facility inventories, construction drawings, approvals, permissions, budgets, procurement records or operating commitments. Every depicted component is conceptual and remains HOLD until an authorised party supplies the applicable release records.

rights_and_method.author: Rainyy-Yan / Codex
rights_and_method.method: Participant-authored generative concept visualisation; no reference photograph, map tile, logo, trademark or real-site image was supplied to the generator.
rights_and_method.reuse_boundary: Use as a proposal illustration only. It cannot evidence existing site conditions, access, heritage placement, operational staffing, accessibility performance or implementation approval.

prototype_cards.name_zh: 众智园：可停止的验证门廊
prototype_cards.spatial_logic: public clearway -> observation/stay edge -> removable safety buffer -> controlled test edge
prototype_cards.acceptance_observation: Record unobstructed passage, legibility of fixed information, separation from testing and successful human handover without a device.
prototype_cards.immediate_close_out: Remove or relocate any component that obstructs public passage, lacks a maintained human fallback or cannot retain the buffer boundary.

prototype_cards.name_zh: AI 原点：无设备门槛的公共知识客厅
prototype_cards.name_en: AI Origin: civic knowledge room without a device gate
prototype_cards.spatial_logic: public entry -> physical knowledge line -> sit/discuss -> human enquiry -> optional AI beside, never ahead of, public exit
prototype_cards.acceptance_observation: Record whether a person can enter, read, rest, ask a human and leave using only the physical route and information.
prototype_cards.immediate_close_out: Remove any interactive layer or service claim when public entry, content maintenance, human response or clearway conditions are not documented.

prototype_cards.name_zh: 大钟寺：到达、判断与可达替代
prototype_cards.name_en: Dazhongsi: arrival, decision and accessible alternative
prototype_cards.spatial_logic: arrival marker -> human handover -> short-pause edge -> public clearway -> confirmed alternative or daily-service frontage
prototype_cards.acceptance_observation: Record a lawful public arrival sequence, a current accessible alternative, short-stay condition and the handover decision without asserting direct station access.
prototype_cards.immediate_close_out: Reroute to a verified public edge or suspend the continuity claim when crossing, entry, accessibility, service or maintenance evidence fails.

phase_boundary: Phase 0 requests and records evidence. Phase 1 is a permitted reversible exercise only. Phase 2 requires discipline-specific review. Phase 3 requires sustainable responsibility, maintenance and auditable close-out; no visual or exercise promotes a Verified SLA automatically.
